title_fa: دادهٔ مجری‌های انسانیِ ویدیوی سه‌بعدی (MPFB / MakeHuman)
note: The MPFB add-on and its skins / clothes / hair (CC0 assets of the MakeHuman community, add-on GPL-3.0) for scenes that have a presenter. The product-only ad templates (turntable, app showcase, 3D logo ...) do not need it, so it installs after Blender and never blocks a render. Mirror: data/up3d/downloads/up3d-blender-user.zip, unpacked to <data>/vendor/blender-user.
